vault13Concept.message: Launcher-capable when the player registers generated local hex-scene.json and character-start.json inputs. The route has original-style character creation, the owned Overseer movie with Escape/skip convergence, and one shared V13ENT save across Hex Tactical and First Person. A diagnostic OpenXR adapter reaches that shared session but is not launcher-enabled: reload/save simulator input, XR door use, campaign-native hands/weapon/UI, and physical-headset acceptance remain open. Only 1 of 96 inventoried local maps is tactically playable; dialogue, quests, complete campaign simulation, and retail combat-formula parity are not connected.

arroyo.message: The owned Fallout 2 Map 126 Temple and Map 3 Arroyo Caves graphs/caches, Temple construction/topology/physics, nonvisual movement, and exact exit state are available. No Godot Map 3 consumer, reciprocal runtime execution, INT, actors, controls, rendered interaction, character/gameplay/save state, FPS, or OpenXR exists, so every mode remains disabled.

vanilla.message: Owned menu and Doc opening plus source-bound HUD/Pip-Boy shell and a bounded preloaded Doc house to Goodsprings exterior to saloon composite. From a completed stage-200 Continue, configured flat input traverses both forward XTEL links; campaign save v5 persists saloon CELL 00106185, opened-container remaining counts, and the player transform. Owned containers support Take One, Take All, and Exit in a two-column flat view. Player deposits, reverse traversal, neighboring CELL streaming, integrated-route OpenXR acceptance, Sunny behavior, complete tile interaction, and retail UI parity remain pending.

jam.message: The owned JAM 4.6 profile transports bounded desktop JVS sprint and JBT time dilation. Missing dependencies and remaining AP, UI, animation, audio, event, and save semantics keep complete JAM play disabled.

vanilla.message: The registered Fallout 3 GOTY profile can run a bounded menu, owned intro, Escape/Skip convergence, CG00 sex/name flow, and source-backed appearance selection through persistent stage 62. Exact Section 4 and stage-65/80/85 contracts compile and validate, but normal progression stops before them because their authored package/dialogue triggers and Vault 101 world do not execute. FPS, Hex, and VR remain launcher-disabled. The texture preview is not a 3D face render.
